title: Report payroll to the ATO each payday (Single Touch Payroll)
what: Report amounts withheld and wages and other qualifying earnings paid to employees to the ATO, by the day each is paid.

sources.title: Taxation Administration Act 1953
sources.locator: Schedule 1, s 389-5(1) (compilation C2026C00468, in force from 2026-10-01)
sources.quote: An entity must notify the Commissioner of an amount of a kind referred to in column 1 of an item in the following table on or before the day referred to in column 2 of that item, if the amount arises as a result of conduct of the entity (such as payment of an amount or provision of a benefit).

sources.title: Taxation Administration Act 1953
sources.quote: Part IA—Administration 3A General administration of Act The Commissioner has the general administration of this Act.
